verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say it can 'Automate questionnaires' as part of accelerating security reviews and trust assurance, so questionnaire automation is a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack shows AI generating answers from the customer's controls or knowledge base, or a draft-and-review workflow, and the only evidence is a single thin, API-framed line. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-drafted answers, grounding in actual controls/knowledge base, a human review/approval workflow for drafts, spreadsheet/portal questionnaire import, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill

citations.quote: Accelerate security reviews and trust assurance. Automate questionnaires and manage your trust center programmatically.
